text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meeting her... was like seeing the sun<n>for the first
time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's been nothing but rough days<n>since I've
become a trainer. All my<n>peers have already
scouted trainees,<n>but not me.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if I'm the only one without a trainee...)

text_block_list.text: Vibe cheeeck!
Whoa, your blue undertones are likefull-on overtones! Yikes, uh, youfeeling down? Then it's time for arager!
Just leave it all to me! Aight, c'mon! ☆
Wahey-heeey! ♪ Pa-pa-pa poooow!

Yo, don't go deflating on me! Hit me<n>with your best
vibes! Leggo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who she is, I don't<n>know where
she's dragged me to,<n>and I don't know what
she's started<n>doing!

text_block_list.name: Party Guy
text_block_list.text:
Ay yo, Daitaku Helios! Throwing a<n>concert today,
aye? Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! ☆ It's less of a concert and<n>more like,
y'know! Just kinda vibing.

text_block_list.name: Rapper
text_block_list.text:
Yo Helios, pass me the microphone!<n>You and me
are clockin' in a new<n>time zone!

text_block_list.name: Dancer
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy. Heard there's some dancing<n>going on here.
Mind if we hop in?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Say less, fam! Let's dance till we<n>drop! I'll join you
onstage!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Look, there's some kinda event<n>going on! Wanna
watch? Or maybe<n>we can even jump in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
More and more people—presumably<n>her
friends—begin to crowd around<n>the burning star that
is Daitaku<n>Helios. They soon form a giant mob.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! If you're feeling what I'm<n>feeling, then
put your hands up!<n>Lemme hear a whoa-oh!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Whoa-oh!
choice_data_list: (This has all the energy of a music festival!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gimme some more volume, people!<n>Say whoa-oh!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: WHOA-OH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what's going on, but<n>something is
enchanting about all<n>this... and I catch my body
starting to<n>move to the beat all on its own.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy! You guys rock! Loving the love!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Wahahaha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dancer
text_block_list.text:
Nice show, Helios. We ate so good<n>today! Ugh, you
really are just the<n>best. Anyway, see you! Hit me
up on<n>LANE sometime!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, bye—oh... Hey! Check out that<n>smile on you!
Now that's a glow-up. ☆
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you cheering me up.
It's all thanks to you cheering me up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She saw that I was in a haze and<n>went out of her
way to drag me out<n>here and lift my mood. But just
as I<n>try to thank her properly...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoa, hold up. You're kinda<n>freaking me out.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but you had a<n>good time letting
loose, yeah? Let's<n>hang out again—wait, just
gimme your<n>LANE! Umastagram works too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're a trainer! I'm at Tracen<n>Academy too! ☆
Gotta be fate, huh?<n>Wild. Anyway, I'll hit you up on
LANE.<n>Later, T-Rain!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I couldn't keep up with her<n>for even a
minute. But I can't deny<n>that her lively spirit rubbed
off on me.
choice_data_list:
(I'll get back to scouting for potential recruits
tomorrow!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It's just that I want to train<n>under
someone more dependab—er, I<n>meant experienced!
Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Feeling refreshed, I find enough<n>courage to reach
out to the runners<n>I've been keeping my eyes on,
but<n>find no takers.
choice_data_list: (That makes the tenth in a row...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't blame them. To the athletes, a<n>trainer is an
important partner who<n>will be there for every step
of their<n>careers. I get it, but...
choice_data_list: At this rate, I won't ever get a contract...

text_block_list.text: Want one with me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, a trainer contract, right? I'm a<n>free agent right
now, so I'd be down!<n>☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Or do I need like official stuff? Like<n>you don't have
a QR code for an app<n>or something? Ugh, that's so
cringe.<n>Can you just put my name down?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you should be agreeing to this so
casually?!

Are you sure you should be agreeing to this so
casually?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sure! I'm low-key super down—oh,<n>but if you're not
up for it, then I'll<n>peace out. Bye! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I know this is my big chance as a<n>trainer, but
agreeing to this without<n>knowing anything about her
won't<n>turn out well for either of us.
choice_data_list: Let me at least see you run before I—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, duh! Say less, I'm on it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's make it a whole<n>thing! My mood
says scrimmage! I'll<n>go grab some peeps, so let's
meet<n>back up at the track!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy. Let's get this party started! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Pft, hahahaha! What's wrong?!<n>You're
sweating bullets! Oh my god,<n>I'm dead!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
How could I not be sweating? The<n>opponents
she's found for her<n>scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...Are all veteran runners of G1 races!
